title: Cover crops and soil organic carbon
content: Cover crops can protect soil from erosion, increase organic matter inputs, improve soil structure, and contribute to soil organic carbon accumulation. Legume cover crops can additionally contribute biologically fixed nitrogen.

title: Habitat diversity and biodiversity
content: Increasing habitat diversity can provide a wider range of resources and niches for organisms. Habitat simplification and land-use change are major pressures affecting terrestrial biodiversity.

title: Agroforestry and ecosystem services
content: Agroforestry integrates trees with crops or livestock and can provide multiple ecosystem services including habitat provision, soil protection, carbon storage, and improved landscape connectivity.

title: Water availability and ecosystem biodiversity
content: Water availability is an important ecological constraint affecting species survival, vegetation productivity, and ecosystem functioning. Maintaining natural water regimes can support aquatic and terrestrial biodiversity.

title: Pollution and biodiversity
content: Pollution is among the major direct drivers of biodiversity loss. Reducing harmful pollutants can reduce ecological stress and improve conditions for sensitive organisms.
